title: [SOA] Move attachment processing to direct model reading
summary: Sales Order Agent now processes PDF and image attachments directly with GPT-4.1 mini to extract structured JSON containing customer references, item details, quantities, and dates, replacing platform-generated attachment text before relevance validation.
key_points: Attachments are sent directly to a multimodal model to extract SOA-focused JSON with item descriptions, identifiers, quantities, and dates
Failed extractions are marked with ExtractionFailed status rather than causing message failure, allowing processing to continue
Extracted JSON is cached on the attachment using the attachment's SystemId to prevent recomputation on subsequent processing
Schema marker in content guards against reprocessing previously extracted attachments
Extraction contract is intentionally open to accommodate varying document structures and item attributes
